annotations.title: Edit a record through a view's own form

description: Updates one record in Development through a view's own "edit" form — the SAME record-update door the dashboard's Records room uses, curated to the view's declared edit.fields, compare-and-swapped on ifVersion (the version dev_view's own row carried): a record that changed since is refused plainly (changed_since_opened) — re-read it with dev_view and reapply. showFrom/showUntil set the record's own publish window, only when the view declares "window": true. Refused if the view declares no "edit" form (and data is sent) or no "window" (and showFrom/showUntil are sent). Development only — Live edit goes through the dashboard; this tool doesn't reach Live yet. On the founder's Logs.

showFrom.description: ISO 8601, or omit to leave it; only when the view declares "window": true
